scan.configuration: Linux x64 / Debug (first command per source)

items.title: Repair asynchronous DNS ownership and synchronization
items.evidence: On POSIX, lastaslu points to static aslu (2136), but starting another pending lookup joins then free(lastaslu) (2114). Worker and caller also access ordinary bool flags concurrently. The Windows worker frees lookup on success while lastaslu can still reference it; cancellation/replacement needs a separate lifetime audit.
items.action: Give each request explicit ownership, join before reuse or destruction, own the hostname, synchronize result publication/cancel, and handle thread creation failure. Preserve the public polling API.
items.validation: Regression: two LOOKUP calls before READ, success/error/cancel, replacement after completion, shutdown, and thread creation failure. Run ASan/LSan and a separate TSan build on POSIX; validate the Windows worker lifecycle too.
items.notes: Implemented owned hostname, joined SDL worker on all lifecycle paths, atomic result publication, scoped IPv4 getaddrinfo, and shutdown-before-Winsock cleanup. Linux Debug engine build and all 44 CTest tests passed. Nine DNS tests passed 100 repetitions under ASan/UBSan/LSan and separate TSan (outside sandbox). One advisory private-enum size warning remains. Windows build/runtime and interactive multiplayer smoke checks pending. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/M01.md.

items.title: Close WAV input exactly once on missing-data failure
items.evidence: SoundLoadWaveFile closes cfptr at 414, then a valid RIFF/WAVE without sample data reaches goto error_state at 423 and cfclose(cfptr) at 484. cfclose frees its CFILE object, so the second close dereferences freed storage.
items.action: Use a scope owner with cfclose as deleter, or immediately clear cfptr after closing. Keep all failure exits consistent.
items.validation: Synthetic RIFF/WAVE with no data, fmt-only, truncated chunks, and a valid sample: failures return cleanly and each handle closes once under ASan.
items.notes: Scoped CFILE ownership prevents the second close. Original missing-data fixture reproduced signal 11 and ASan heap-use-after-free; fixed loader passes 25 WAV tests, 100 ASan/UBSan/LSan repetitions, the Debug engine build, and all 69 Debug CTest tests. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/M02-M03.md.

items.title: Avoid overwriting owned WAV sample buffers
items.evidence: The chunk loop permits fmt/data/fmt/data sequences (f_fmt is cleared after data). Allocations at 372 or 391 overwrite the same SoundFiles pointer without freeing the previous allocation. Error cleanup can only free the latest pointer. This is a source-visible leak path, not yet reproduced with a fixture.
items.action: Preserve the last-complete-waveform-wins policy, releasing earlier buffers even across bit-depth changes. Hold samples locally until parsing and conversion succeed; check chunk arithmetic, file and allocation bounds, odd 16-bit byte counts, and RIFF padding.
items.validation: Generated 8/16-bit multi-chunk and malformed WAV fixtures; repeated load/free under LSan; unchanged playback for supported single-data files.
items.notes: Implemented scoped local sample owners with publication after validation, preserving existing samples on failure. Confirmed a 10-byte leak in the original repeated-waveform fixture. Fixed loader passes 25 generated WAV tests x 100 ASan/UBSan/LSan repetitions, a Debug engine build, and all 69 Debug CTest tests. Supported PCM sample values/alignment/conversion verified; in-game audio smoke check still pending. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/M02-M03.md.

items.title: Make registry replacement allocation-safe
items.evidence: CreateRecord frees existing data at 418 before allocating its replacement; allocations at 423/427/455/460 are immediately dereferenced without checking failure. An allocation failure can crash or destroy the previous saved setting.
items.action: Allocate and populate a temporary owner first, then commit the replacement. Find the existing record without allocating olddata just to copy an unused value; reject unsupported record types.
items.validation: Inject allocation failure at each allocation, verify no null dereference, no partial record insertion, no lost old value, and registry import/export round trips.
items.notes: Record values are allocated/copied before replacement or insertion; failure preserves the old record and input may alias the old value. Removed olddata, rejected invalid types/names, and cleared stale/failed key selections. Twelve registry tests include failure injection at each record allocation and key allocation, retries, aliasing, type changes and export/import. Original null-write and alias use-after-free reproduced under sanitizers; fixed suite passed 100 ASan/UBSan/LSan repetitions. Debug engine build and all 92 CTest tests passed. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/M04-B01.md.

items.title: Roll back partial raw-console initialization
items.evidence: con_raw_Create allocates two global buffers and returns false if either fails without releasing the successful allocation. con_raw_Destroy can release it later, so whether it leaks depends on caller cleanup; a retry can overwrite the retained pointer.
items.action: Use temporary owners, commit only after both allocations succeed, and make retry/destroy idempotent.
items.validation: Fail first and second allocation separately, retry initialization, and destroy after failure under LSan.
items.notes: Console buffers are prepared in temporary owners and published together. Failed/repeated initialization and destroy are safe, failed reinit preserves pending input, and closed consoles do not poll keys. Original failed-init/retry leaked 84 bytes under LSan. Nine console tests passed 100 ASan/UBSan/LSan repetitions plus Release; all 109 Debug tests and the engine build passed. Keyboard events were simulated; real gameplay was not run. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/M05-B02.md.

items.title: Clean up CFILE allocation failures when Error returns
items.evidence: At 8b4c924c, disk and both HOG opening paths call Error after a failed CFILE allocation, then dereference null. Error can return in Debug. Failed disk filename duplication also publishes an incomplete handle. Five injected handle-failure cases exit 139 with the original code; the filename-failure regression also fails.
items.action: Close the acquired FILE before reporting failure; free a partially allocated disk CFILE if filename duplication fails, then return null if Error returns. Preserve retry and the lifetime of other active HOG member streams.
items.validation: Inject disk handle/name and explicit/searched HOG handle failures with cached/reopened streams. Verify cleanup before return, active member contents and successful retry. Run Debug/Release, ASan/UBSan/LSan and focused clang-tidy.
items.notes: All four failure exits release resources before Error and return null if it returns. Seven Linux allocation regressions pass Debug and Release; 100 ASan/UBSan/LSan repetitions pass outside the sandbox. All 139 Debug CTest tests and the Debug engine build pass. Focused clang-tidy 18.1.3 emits no NullDereference or unix.Malloc findings. Linux RTL allocator/linker wrappers simulate a returning Debug Error handler; no interactive dialog or cross-platform fault injection was performed. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/M06-T03.md.

items.title: Bound INF symbolic operand expansion
items.evidence: ParseLine accepts oprlen and bounds the initial operand through CleanupStr, but expands a stored symbol using strcpy(operand, sym) at 180. A symbol stored from a larger operand can exceed a later caller buffer. Generic strcpy diagnostics alone do not prove each other copy is unsafe.
items.action: Honor oprlen during expansion and define error/truncation semantics. Reject null/zero-capacity operands and malformed token sequences before pointer arithmetic.
items.validation: Regression with symbol expansion into smaller capacity, exact boundary, zero capacity, delimiter-only lines and missing symbols, using ASan.
items.notes: Symbol lookup uses the full reference and checks expanded length before copying; overflow/missing symbols return ERROR with empty output. Literal truncation stays compatible. Invalid buffers, delimiter-only lines and closed parser state are handled safely; symbol construction has scoped ownership. Eleven INF tests passed 100 ASan/UBSan/LSan repetitions; original stack-buffer-overflow reproduced. Debug engine build and all 92 CTest tests passed. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/M04-B01.md.

items.title: Check file-stat failure and file-size narrowing
items.evidence: ddio_GetFileLength ignores fstat failure and narrows off_t st_size to int. clang-tidy reports narrowing at 118; on fstat failure info is not safely initialized. Large files can produce invalid lengths.
items.action: Check the system call and explicitly reject sizes above the legacy API limit, or migrate callers together to a wider type after auditing file formats. Avoid simply casting away the warning.
items.validation: Invalid descriptors, normal/empty files, and sparse files above INT_MAX; verify callers handle the failure sentinel.
items.notes: POSIX file length now checks fstat and int bounds; disk CFILE rejects failed queries instead of converting -1 to an unsigned size. Windows counterpart uses _filelengthi64 with the same bounds; Windows build/runtime remains pending. Original sparse lengths wrapped to -2147483648 and 17; original CFILE published the unsigned error size. Eight DDIO/CFILE tests passed 100 sanitizer repetitions, all 109 Debug tests passed, and the engine rebuilt. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/M05-B02.md.

items.title: Avoid truncating pilot-preview rotation arithmetic
items.evidence: The 30-degrees-per-second preview expression uses (65535 / 360), so integer division truncates before float multiplication. clang-tidy flags line 2914; expected angle-unit conversion should be checked against engine conventions.
items.action: Use an existing angle conversion helper or intentional floating-point conversion while preserving wraparound and angle representation.
items.validation: Check expected rotation at fixed elapsed times and visually verify the ship preview.
items.notes: Preview rotation (pilot.cpp, and the identical TelCom.cpp expression) now converts with 65536.0f / 360.0f. Expected per-frame angle units at 1/60, 1/30, 0.1 and 0.5 s are identical to the old values (91/182/546/2730); 1 s differs by one unit, so the preview cannot look different and no visual check was needed. Debug/Release builds and CTest pass. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/B03-D01-D03.md.

items.title: Propagate renderer initialization failure and make partial cleanup safe
items.evidence: rend_SetPreferredState ignores rend_ReInit failure and returns success. If gamma also changes, rend_SetGammaValue dereferences gRenderer after failed setup left it empty. rend_Init publishes Renderer_initted before successful initialization. opengl_Init's failed-setup cleanup can issue GL calls before pointers/context exist. Source-confirmed, without injected GL failure or gameplay reproduction yet.
items.action: Publish readiness only after successful initialization, release partial resources only with valid GL entry points/context, propagate reinitialization failure before gamma/draw operations, and audit callers so failed setup stops rendering. Make cleanup and retry safe; do not hide missing initialization with blanket optional guards.
items.validation: Inject SDL/window/context/GL-loading/framebuffer failures at startup and reinit, including simultaneous resolution/gamma changes. Verify failure propagation, no GL calls without context, repeatable shutdown, no leaks, and successful retry/drawing. Run a real GL smoke session and supported platform builds.
items.notes: Implemented checked SDL3 initialization/library loading, persistent per-context entry-point reload, readiness publication after complete initialization, centralized partial cleanup, checked cache/upload allocation, bounded diagnostics, failure propagation before gamma and checked engine callers. Linux Debug/Release engine builds and 30 lifecycle cases pass; 169 Debug CTest cases pass with one opt-in GL case skipped, then the real-GL case passes separately. ASan/UBSan/LSan: 30 cases x 100 repetitions pass. Original code fails the reload test and three failure comparisons exit 139. Windows build/runtime and interactive settings/gameplay/debugger checks remain pending, so this stays Review. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/B04-T03.md.

items.title: Expose bounded network timing policy
items.evidence: NETTIMEOUT=300, NETRETRYTIME=.75 and MIN_NET_RETRYTIME=.2 are compile-time defaults. NETTIMEOUT drives both connection wait and established-peer expiry; these are different operational needs.
items.action: Introduce validated runtime connect/idle/retry settings through existing settings/argument infrastructure. Preserve defaults; enforce positive finite values, retry minimum <= base, and sensible limits relative to heartbeat. Keep packet layouts and sizes fixed.
items.validation: Default behavior, override precedence, invalid/NaN/negative/extreme values, delayed/lossy loopback peers and disconnect/reconnect tests.
items.notes: Added nw_timing_policy (lib/net_timing.h) with separate connect and idle timeouts plus base/minimum resend intervals, set from -netconnecttimeout, -netidletimeout, -netretrytime and -netminretrytime. Defaults are unchanged (compile-time asserted against NETTIMEOUT/NETRETRYTIME/MIN_NET_RETRYTIME); values must be finite plain decimals within documented ranges (idle >= 3 heartbeats, min retry <= retry); malformed values are ignored and inconsistent combinations keep all defaults, with warnings. The effective policy is logged; packet layouts and heartbeat are unchanged; options documented in USAGE.md. Six policy tests pass and the Debug game logged accepted and rejected overrides correctly. Delayed/lossy loopback, disconnect/reconnect and an actual connect-timeout run are pending (networking.cpp has no standalone test harness; auto-connect stops at pilot selection), plus Windows, so this stays Review. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/C01.md.

items.title: Make HTTP connection timeout an explicit option
items.evidence: HttpClient sets a five-second connection timeout in its constructor; the wrapper exposes proxy configuration but no timeout option. Slow connections require rebuilding to change this policy.
items.action: Add an options object with connection/read/write timeouts and unchanged defaults; map user-facing download policy through the existing configuration layer, without an unbounded wait.
items.validation: Local HTTP fixture: delayed connection/read, cancellation and default/override/invalid-value cases; document timeout units.
items.notes: D3::HttpClient now accepts D3::HttpTimeouts (connect/read/write, whole seconds; connect 1-60, read/write 1-600; invalid values fall back to the previous defaults of 5/300/5). Mission downloads honor -httpconnecttimeout and -httpreadtimeout (malformed values warned and ignored; effective values logged; documented in USAGE.md, read = inactivity not total time). Fixed a null dereference in the Descent3 Online game-list fetch when a request fails. Nine loopback tests pass: delayed response with short/long read timeouts, invalid fallback, cancellation via progress callback, refused connection and parsing/range cases; the game logged accepted/rejected options. A delayed-connection fixture, a real mission download and Windows remain unverified, so this stays Review. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/C02.md.

items.title: Resolve the ignored SDL sound-buffer option
items.evidence: InitSoundLib parses -sdlSndSize into sampleCount, but no subsequent operation consumes it. clang-tidy reports the dead fallback assignment at 91. The existing option gives users no effective control over buffering.
items.action: Verify the installed SDL3 buffer-setting API and either wire a validated value before device creation or retire the option with an explicit message. Keep 22050-Hz content interpretation fixed until a separate resampling design exists.
items.validation: Default, valid and malformed options; inspect actual device buffer size and latency; playback and startup/reinit smoke checks.
items.notes: -sdlSndSize now requests the device buffer through SDL_HINT_AUDIO_DEVICE_SAMPLE_FRAMES before the device opens (integer 64-8192 device sample frames; malformed/out-of-range values are ignored with a warning; no option keeps SDL's default; the SDL environment variable takes precedence). The obtained buffer size is logged. Three parser tests pass; an SDL probe on PipeWire obtained the requested 256/2048 frames (default 1024); the Debug game logged a 512-frame device for -sdlSndSize 512 and fell back to 1024 with a warning for an invalid value. Audible playback, in-game sound reinit and Windows are not yet verified (user check), so this stays Review. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/C03.md.

items.title: Remove selected permanently disabled implementations
items.evidence: #if 0 removes the socket select block and UI focus-box implementation from every configuration. Additional disabled physics/editor blocks exist; their intended future behavior needs review before wholesale deletion.
items.action: Remove the two small disabled blocks after recording intent in the change description. Inventory physics/editor blocks in separate patches; use version history for abandoned code.
items.validation: Build affected modules on supported configurations and inspect preprocessor-only diff. UI/input smoke checks if surrounding active logic changes.
items.notes: Removed the networking select() and UI focus-box #if 0 blocks; the receive loop comment now states the non-blocking read. Debug preprocessed output of both files is identical apart from __LINE__ values, and #if 0 is configuration-independent. Remaining inventory for separate review: physics 3 blocks in 2 files, editor 56 blocks in 10 files. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/B03-D01-D03.md.

items.title: Remove unused network scaffolding after symbol audit
items.evidence: MAX_CONNECT_TRIES appears only at its definition. nw_LoadThreadLibrary has an empty compiled body and its only apparent call is inside a comment. An external symbol can still have consumers outside this tree.
items.action: Confirm no export/dlsym/module dependency on nw_LoadThreadLibrary, then delete the empty helper, obsolete pthread comments, and unused macro. Do not infer that platform-only functions are unused from a Linux scan.
items.validation: Repository-wide reference search, exported-symbol review, Linux/Windows link checks and multiplayer module load smoke test.
items.notes: nw_LoadThreadLibrary was removed in M01; the file-local MAX_CONNECT_TRIES macro had no references in the repository and is removed. A macro defines no symbol, so exports, Windows linking and module loading cannot change. Debug/Release builds and CTest pass. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/B03-D01-D03.md.

items.title: Remove verified dead stores without changing side effects
items.evidence: clang-tidy reports unused use_buffer stores at 1175/1187, rcvaddr at 1365, rcode at 2598, and num_write=0 before goto done at mixer lines 275/288. It also reports assignments inside list traversal conditions; those loops still have required side effects.
items.action: Remove only redundant assignments and declarations proven unused on all platform branches. Preserve calls, packet state updates, and list traversal/unlink operations.
items.validation: Rerun DeadStores on affected files; networking resend/ack and mixer stop/loop regression cases.
items.notes: Removed the use_buffer, rcvaddr and rcode dead stores in networking, two num_write = 0 stores before goto done in the mixer, and a redundant trailing return. Release machine code of networking.cpp and mixer.cpp is identical before and after (line numbers held constant); DeadStores and redundant-control-flow report zero findings in both files; the gate reports 35 findings, zero new; Debug/Release CTest 218/218. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/B03-D01-D03.md.

items.title: Apply small C++17 modernization batches
items.evidence: The sample includes nullptr and override warnings in DDIO and platform headers. These are maintainability opportunities, not proof of runtime defects.
items.action: Apply reviewed, file-scoped nullptr/override/defaulted-member changes; format changed files only. Keep public signatures, serialized controller IDs and pilot formats compatible.
items.validation: Build and run affected CTest groups; for input changes use temporary XDG_DATA_HOME and verify dialogs, saved bindings and gameplay.
items.notes: Applied file-scoped modernize-use-override fixes to linux/lnxapp.h (7), ddio/sdlcontroller.h and sndlib/sdlsound.h; the named ddio.h/mixer.h nullptr findings were already fixed upstream. No signatures, serialized IDs or pilot formats changed (override is a compile-time check only). Debug/Release builds and CTest 218/218 (12 Control tests) pass. Remaining advisory modernization counts are recorded for later batches. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/T01-T02.md.

items.title: Measure performance suggestions before applying them
items.evidence: clang-tidy flags float-to-double fabs promotion in sdlcontroller and enum sizes/padding in shared types. Changing shared layouts for size alone may break ABI, serialization or DLL boundaries.
items.action: Try appropriate std::abs float overloads and benchmark controller/mixer paths. Keep enum/layout advice informational until all persistence/network/module uses are audited.
items.validation: Compare input values at dead-zone thresholds, benchmark representative workloads, and require size/offset plus format-compatibility checks for any layout change.
items.notes: Replaced 12 fabs(float) calls in SDLControllerCore with std::abs(float). An exhaustive comparison over all 2^32 floats at seven dead-zone thresholds (> and >=) found zero mismatches; a 2.05e8-call microbenchmark showed no measurable difference, so this clears warnings without claiming a speedup. Enum-size and padding advice stays informational; no shared layout changed. Builds and CTest pass. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/T01-T02.md.

items.title: Triage analyzer assumptions and startup invariants
items.evidence: Registry olddata leak assumes LookupRecord misses after GetDataSize found the same record; this may be infeasible without mutation. WAV uninitialized warning at 467 skips the conversion loop then enters an identical-bounds loop, suggesting analyzer imprecision. cfopen null warning follows Error(); renderer optional warnings require proving gRenderer initialization order.
items.action: Reproduce each path or document its invariant with a focused test. Audit Error return/termination behavior and renderer startup/shutdown. Fix genuine defects; suppress only the exact proven false positive with a rationale.
items.validation: Attach path analysis and a regression or documented invariant for each disposition; no blanket analyzer suppression.
items.notes: Original Linux candidates now have dispositions: registry and WAV warnings were removed and validated by M04 and M02/M03; M06 reproduced and fixed the returning-Error CFILE failure. B04 repaired renderer failure propagation, partial cleanup and per-context GL loading. Thirty lifecycle regressions pass Debug/Release, 3,000 sanitizer executions pass, and actual offscreen GL drawing/reopen/reinit passes. Twenty optional-access diagnostics remain under the documented successful-initialization/main-thread precondition; no suppressions or blanket drawing guards were added. Remaining Windows and interactive renderer acceptance is tracked in B04. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/B04-T03.md.

items.title: Establish a reproducible incremental clang-tidy gate
items.evidence: CMake already exports a compilation database; no repository .clang-tidy policy was present. The current 719 unique diagnostics include substantial modernization noise and header repeats have been deduplicated.
items.action: Pin clang-tidy 18.1.3 initially, select one compile command per configuration/source, baseline first-party diagnostics and gate new reviewed correctness findings. Add modernization/performance checks as advisory jobs. Never run blanket -fix across the legacy tree.
items.validation: Demonstrate one seeded new warning fails the gate while unchanged baseline passes; excluded third-party warnings do not change the result. Capture compiler errors/timeouts as failures.
items.notes: Location-aware comparison maps unchanged source lines against baseline Git revisions in both directions. Real clang-tidy tests verify a seeded warning fails, an unchanged baseline and a line insertion pass, an identical warning replacing another in a different function fails, third-party log entries are excluded, compiler errors/timeouts/missing results fail, and missing baseline history fails closed. Three newly visible existing diagnostics were reviewed and recorded individually. Claude removed the tools' hidden rtk dependency (scan/compare/test now call git and clang-tidy directly; --clang-tidy selects the binary); with rtk absent from PATH the end-to-end test ran (not skipped) and the full gate passed with 42 findings, zero new. All acceptance criteria are met, so A01 is Done. Known limits: the repository has no CI workflow, so the optional code_review_gate target is not automatically enforced; moved identical code can be mismatched; baseline Git objects are required. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/A01.md.

items.title: Extend coverage across modules and platform configurations
items.evidence: Only 16 of 365 unique entries in the local Linux build database were scanned. Windows/DirectPlay, editor, most gameplay/physics, plugins and third-party internals were not analyzed exhaustively; absence of warnings is not proof of safety.
items.action: Run bounded subsystem batches, then separate Linux Release/Debug and Windows/editor databases. Include runtime sanitizers and representative gameplay/multiplayer smoke sessions, without modifying commercial assets.
items.validation: Publish configuration-specific file coverage and triage outcomes; build and CTest pass per supported platform and record runtime/sanitizer evidence.
items.notes: Batch 1 scanned all 387 Linux Debug TUs (13,259 first-party diagnostics; 1,483 analyzer). Batch 2 triaged the 83 high-signal analyzer findings: fixed real defects including a UITextItem use-after-free, PCX heap overflow and truncation handling, unbounded remote-admin packet lengths (network over-read), inverted range checks in Osiris mission flags and SOAR helpers (plus a wrong terrain index), an unterminated restored OMMS script name, uninitialized cfile reads, AI divide-by-zero and null guards, cinematic camera null, guidebot uninitialized handles, encoder teardown and several leaks; the rest are documented false positives, OOM-only deferrals or advisory opt-in checks. 10 new tests (ASan-clean x100; originals reproduce UAF and overflow); CTest 228/228 Debug and Release; gate 0 new. Remaining: strcpy/DeadStores bulk decisions, MultiGetString audit, Release/Windows/editor databases, runtime/gameplay checks; Done also needs M01/M03. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/A02.md.

Thirty lifecycle regressions pass Debug/Release, 3,000 sanitizer executions pass, and actual offscreen GL drawing/reopen/reinit passes. Twenty optional-access diagnostics remain under the documented successful-initialization/main-thread precondition; no suppressions or blanket drawing guards were added. Remaining Windows and interactive renderer acceptance is tracked in B04. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/B04-T03.md.

history.to: Implemented checked SDL3 initialization/library loading, persistent per-context entry-point reload, readiness publication after complete initialization, centralized partial cleanup, checked cache/upload allocation, bounded diagnostics, failure propagation before gamma and checked engine callers. Linux Debug/Release engine builds and 30 lifecycle cases pass; 169 Debug CTest cases pass with one opt-in GL case skipped, then the real-GL case passes separately. ASan/UBSan/LSan: 30 cases x 100 repetitions pass. Original code fails the reload test and three failure comparisons exit 139. Windows build/runtime and interactive settings/gameplay/debugger checks remain pending, so this stays Review. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/B04-T03.md.

B04 validation found that CMake post-build GTest discovery shares files across configurations and can run the last-linked Release binary under ctest -C Debug. The new renderer target uses PRE_TEST; local full-suite validation sets CMAKE_GTEST_DISCOVER_TESTS_DISCOVERY_MODE=PRE_TEST and audits executable paths. Carry this configuration-specific discovery policy into the reproducible CI/developer gate. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/B04-T03.md.

history.to: Location-aware comparison maps unchanged source lines against baseline Git revisions in both directions. Real clang-tidy tests verify a seeded warning fails, an unchanged baseline and a line insertion pass, an identical warning replacing another in a different function fails, third-party log entries are excluded, compiler errors/timeouts/missing results fail, and missing baseline history fails closed. Three newly visible existing diagnostics were reviewed and recorded individually. Claude removed the tools' hidden rtk dependency (scan/compare/test now call git and clang-tidy directly; --clang-tidy selects the binary); with rtk absent from PATH the end-to-end test ran (not skipped) and the full gate passed with 42 findings, zero new. All acceptance criteria are met, so A01 is Done. Known limits: the repository has no CI workflow, so the optional code_review_gate target is not automatically enforced; moved identical code can be mismatched; baseline Git objects are required. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/A01.md.

-sdlSndSize now requests the device buffer through SDL_HINT_AUDIO_DEVICE_SAMPLE_FRAMES before the device opens (integer 64-8192 device sample frames; malformed/out-of-range values are ignored with a warning; no option keeps SDL's default; the SDL environment variable takes precedence). The obtained buffer size is logged. Three parser tests pass; an SDL probe on PipeWire obtained the requested 256/2048 frames (default 1024); the Debug game logged a 512-frame device for -sdlSndSize 512 and fell back to 1024 with a warning for an invalid value. Audible playback, in-game sound reinit and Windows are not yet verified (user check), so this stays Review. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/C03.md.

Added nw_timing_policy (lib/net_timing.h) with separate connect and idle timeouts plus base/minimum resend intervals, set from -netconnecttimeout, -netidletimeout, -netretrytime and -netminretrytime. Defaults are unchanged (compile-time asserted against NETTIMEOUT/NETRETRYTIME/MIN_NET_RETRYTIME); values must be finite plain decimals within documented ranges (idle >= 3 heartbeats, min retry <= retry); malformed values are ignored and inconsistent combinations keep all defaults, with warnings. The effective policy is logged; packet layouts and heartbeat are unchanged; options documented in USAGE.md. Six policy tests pass and the Debug game logged accepted and rejected overrides correctly. Delayed/lossy loopback, disconnect/reconnect and an actual connect-timeout run are pending (networking.cpp has no standalone test harness; auto-connect stops at pilot selection), plus Windows, so this stays Review. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/C01.md.

D3::HttpClient now accepts D3::HttpTimeouts (connect/read/write, whole seconds; connect 1-60, read/write 1-600; invalid values fall back to the previous defaults of 5/300/5). Mission downloads honor -httpconnecttimeout and -httpreadtimeout (malformed values warned and ignored; effective values logged; documented in USAGE.md, read = inactivity not total time). Fixed a null dereference in the Descent3 Online game-list fetch when a request fails. Nine loopback tests pass: delayed response with short/long read timeouts, invalid fallback, cancellation via progress callback, refused connection and parsing/range cases; the game logged accepted/rejected options. A delayed-connection fixture, a real mission download and Windows remain unverified, so this stays Review. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/C02.md.

Preview rotation (pilot.cpp, and the identical TelCom.cpp expression) now converts with 65536.0f / 360.0f. Expected per-frame angle units at 1/60, 1/30, 0.1 and 0.5 s are identical to the old values (91/182/546/2730); 1 s differs by one unit, so the preview cannot look different and no visual check was needed. Debug/Release builds and CTest pass. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/B03-D01-D03.md.

Removed the networking select() and UI focus-box #if 0 blocks; the receive loop comment now states the non-blocking read. Debug preprocessed output of both files is identical apart from __LINE__ values, and #if 0 is configuration-independent. Remaining inventory for separate review: physics 3 blocks in 2 files, editor 56 blocks in 10 files. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/B03-D01-D03.md.

history.from: Partial work in M01 removed the obsolete empty nw_LoadThreadLibrary helper and commented pthread implementation. MAX_CONNECT_TRIES and the remaining symbol/export audit are still outstanding; this item remains Backlog.
history.to: nw_LoadThreadLibrary was removed in M01; the file-local MAX_CONNECT_TRIES macro had no references in the repository and is removed. A macro defines no symbol, so exports, Windows linking and module loading cannot change. Debug/Release builds and CTest pass. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/B03-D01-D03.md.

Removed the use_buffer, rcvaddr and rcode dead stores in networking, two num_write = 0 stores before goto done in the mixer, and a redundant trailing return. Release machine code of networking.cpp and mixer.cpp is identical before and after (line numbers held constant); DeadStores and redundant-control-flow report zero findings in both files; the gate reports 35 findings, zero new; Debug/Release CTest 218/218. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/B03-D01-D03.md.

Applied file-scoped modernize-use-override fixes to linux/lnxapp.h (7), ddio/sdlcontroller.h and sndlib/sdlsound.h; the named ddio.h/mixer.h nullptr findings were already fixed upstream. No signatures, serialized IDs or pilot formats changed (override is a compile-time check only). Debug/Release builds and CTest 218/218 (12 Control tests) pass. Remaining advisory modernization counts are recorded for later batches. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/T01-T02.md.

Replaced 12 fabs(float) calls in SDLControllerCore with std::abs(float). An exhaustive comparison over all 2^32 floats at seven dead-zone thresholds (> and >=) found zero mismatches; a 2.05e8-call microbenchmark showed no measurable difference, so this clears warnings without claiming a speedup. Enum-size and padding advice stays informational; no shared layout changed. Builds and CTest pass. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/T01-T02.md.

Of the analyzer findings, 1,201 are strcpy and 199 DeadStores; 83 higher-signal candidates (21 NullDereference, 11 Malloc, ...) form the triage queue for batch 2. Coverage per module and every analyzer finding are in docs/code-review/a02-linux-debug.json. Remaining: triage, Release/Windows/editor databases, runtime and gameplay checks; also blocked from Done by M01/M03 (Review). Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/A02.md.

Batch 2 triaged the 83 high-signal analyzer findings: fixed real defects including a UITextItem use-after-free, PCX heap overflow and truncation handling, unbounded remote-admin packet lengths (network over-read), inverted range checks in Osiris mission flags and SOAR helpers (plus a wrong terrain index), an unterminated restored OMMS script name, uninitialized cfile reads, AI divide-by-zero and null guards, cinematic camera null, guidebot uninitialized handles, encoder teardown and several leaks; the rest are documented false positives, OOM-only deferrals or advisory opt-in checks. 10 new tests (ASan-clean x100; originals reproduce UAF and overflow); CTest 228/228 Debug and Release; gate 0 new. Remaining: strcpy/DeadStores bulk decisions, MultiGetString audit, Release/Windows/editor databases, runtime/gameplay checks; Done also needs M01/M03. Evidence: docs/code-review/validation/A02.md.
